description: One day of Search Console: the property's total, one page, one query, or one query on one page. Kept forever: past Search Console's 16 months these rows are the only copy. Written only by the nightly pull and the backfill, which replace each day they read in full; Search Console publishes final figures two or three days late, so the last week is re-read every night.

fields.label: Date
fields.description: Search Console's date (Pacific time, as Google reports it).

fields.label: Value
fields.description: The page URL (Page and Page Query rows) or the query (Query rows), as Search Console reported it. Blank for the total.

fields.label: Normalized Path
fields.description: The join key with GA4 landing pages (rules.normalize_page). Page and Page Query rows.

fields.label: Query
fields.description: The search that landed on the page. Page Query rows only: which searches bring people to which page.

fields.label: Property
fields.description: The property form Search Console accepted (sc-domain: or a URL prefix).

fields.label: Average Position
fields.description: Search Console's average position for the row. Averages across rows are weighted by impressions.

name: Search Console Daily Metric
